hero.title: Digital Maritime Operations
hero.subtitle: AI-powered digital twin systems and predictive intelligence for asset integrity, maintenance planning, and operational visibility across vessel lifecycles.

about.title: ABOUT US
about.missionText: A'SHERIV produces maritime operations platforms and digital twin systems that unify vessel data, telemetry, and operational decisions into structured intelligence layers. We enable shipyards, operators, and stakeholders to make data-driven decisions that support safer operations, reduced unplanned failures, and clearer accountability across the vessel lifecycle.
about.visionText: To create a maritime analytics value chain through digital twin systems and AI-powered risk analysis, supporting the next generation needs of shipyards, operators, and the broader maritime industry. We aim to establish digital twin adoption as standard practice for high-value maritime assets.
about.description: A'SHERIV works with shipyards, operators, owners, engineers, insurers, class societies, and OEMs to deploy operational platforms that integrate with existing production, maintenance, and inspection workflows.

platform.title: ASHMOP
platform.description: AshMOP is A'SHERIV's maritime operations platform that connects vessel assets, events, telemetry, and decisions into a consistent digital twin model with role-based access for shipyards, operators, engineers, and regulatory parties.

1.title: Digital Twin Workspace
1.description: 3D asset navigation, system drill-down, risk overlays, and lifecycle context for comprehensive vessel understanding.

2.title: Telemetry & Health Monitoring
2.description: Health scoring from component → system → vessel with trend and anomaly signals for predictive maintenance planning.

3.title: Operational Logs to Structured Data
3.description: Convert operational notes into measurable events, decisions, and evidence for traceability and compliance.

4.title: Evidence Pack Builder
4.description: Time-window evidence exports for insurance, class, charterers, and internal audit with structured documentation.

5.title: Shipyard Configuration System
5.description: Build specifications, BOM, QC checklists, and operational feedback loops from operations to design.

6.title: Scenario Playback & Validation
6.description: Synthetic scenarios to validate workflows before live integrations and system deployments.

integration.title: SHIPYARD INTEGRATION
integration.description: A'SHERIV works with shipyards to deploy digital twin systems integrated with production, maintenance, and inspection workflows. Our approach extends beyond traditional vessel management, delivering detailed assessments that support informed decision-making and risk mitigation.

production.title: Production & Build
production.description: Build configuration, QC traceability, and delivery documentation integrated with operational systems. Shipyard build specifications, BOM management, and QC checklists connected to vessel operations.

operations.title: Operations & Maintenance
operations.description: Operational data feedback into design and build specifications. Telemetry monitoring, maintenance planning, log traceability, and decision support for operational fleets.

project.title: Project: Data Collection and AI-Assisted Decision Platform for Shipyard Production Processes
project.description: A software platform that analyzes data obtained from shipyard production processes to provide quality, efficiency, and traceability. The platform also aims to obtain uncollected critical data through local sensor prototypes and includes three modules: Discovery, Traceability Core, and AI Decision Support.

modules.discovery: Discovery Module: Data collection and analysis from shipyard production processes
modules.traceability: Traceability Core: Quality control, documentation, and traceability systems
modules.ai: AI Decision Support: AI-powered decision support for production optimization
